description: Approve or reject a pending follow request in Nextcloud Social. This publishes to the fediverse: the action is delivered to other servers immediately and cannot be recalled. A public post is world-readable. Approving lets that account see this user’s followers-only posts.

account_id.description: The id of the requesting account, from social_list_follow_requests

action.description: authorize to approve, reject to decline

name: social_respond_follow_request
title: Approve or Reject Social Follow Request
